results.content: Amid President Donald Trump’s record-low approval ratings nationally, a new YouGov/Economist projection shows the president's net job approval is negative in all but three states. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6). The lowest net job approval rating for Trump was in D.C. results.content: YouGov polls about 1,500 members of its national opt-in panel weekly using online questionnaires. State-level approval rates are “estimated” based on demographic characteristics, voting behavior, the state’s voting history and other data. Nationally, YouGov’s tracker shows 34% approving of Trump’s job performance and 61% disapproving, for a net approval rating of -27.

While Trump polled underwater on every issue with the tracker in February, March and May, this is the first time his rating has fallen well below zero across the board. The erosion spans issues Republicans have traditionally owned, which suggests the president is entering the final stretch before the midterms facing the most intense opposition of his second term.
